items.title: Till / Until (যতক্ষণ না…)
items.body:
Wait here till I come back.
We shall stay here until the rain stops.
Work hard until success comes.

items.title: When (যখন … তখন)
items.body:
When the teacher entered, the students stood up.
Miraj will go to India when he has got a visa.

items.title: After (পরে / যখন … তখন)
items.body:
After you take medicine, you will feel better.
The patient died after she had been admitted into a hospital.

items.title: While (যখন; কোনো কাজ চলাকালীন)
items.body:
While I was walking in my garden, I saw a bird.
Do not play while the class is going on.

items.title: While / Whereas (অন্যদিকে, পক্ষান্তরে, অথচ)
items.body:
I am punctual while my brother is not so.
He has passed while his sister has failed.

items.title: Before (পূর্বে, আগে)
items.body:
We had reached college before the bell rang.
He had closed the door before he left the house.

items.title: As (যেমন / সময়ের সাথে সাথে)
items.body:
As he grew older, he became weak.
The fog disappeared as the sun rose.
Do as I tell you.

items.title: As soon as (যেই মাত্র … সেই মাত্র)
items.body:
As soon as we saw the snake, it fled away.
I will send the documents as soon as I finish checking them.

items.title: As long as (যতক্ষণ পর্যন্ত; যতদিন)
items.body:
I shall be beside you as long as you are honest.
God will help us as long as we are honest.

items.title: Whenever (যখনই … তখনই)
items.body:
Whenever he comes here, he meets me.
I become happy whenever I see him.

items.title: It is / was … since (… সময় ধরে / … পর)
items.body:
It is long since I met him last.
It was five years since we had met last.
Five years have passed since I went home.

items.title: Because / As / Since (যেহেতু … সেহেতু)
items.body:
Since he was ill, he could not walk.
He could not pass because he did not study well.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — কারণ, উদ্দেশ্য ও ফল (Reason • Purpose • Result)

items.title: Lest (নচেৎ, পাছে, যাতে না)
items.body:
Be punctual lest you should lag behind.
He ran away lest he should be arrested.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — কারণ, উদ্দেশ্য ও ফল (Reason • Purpose • Result)

items.title: So that / In order that / That (যাতে)
items.body:
They work hard so that they can grow a good amount of crops.
They had to put on warm clothes so that they could keep their bodies warm.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — কারণ, উদ্দেশ্য ও ফল (Reason • Purpose • Result)

items.title: So … that (এত … যে)
items.body:
He is so weak that he cannot carry this load.
The book was so captivating that I couldn't sleep before finishing it.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — কারণ, উদ্দেশ্য ও ফল (Reason • Purpose • Result)

items.title: So much / So many … that (এত বেশি … যে)
items.body:
Tarim has eaten so much food that he cannot walk now.
There are so many stars that I cannot count them.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — কারণ, উদ্দেশ্য ও ফল (Reason • Purpose • Result)

items.title: Too … to / … enough to (এত … যে করা যায় না / যথেষ্ট … করার জন্য)
items.body:
The box was too heavy for me to carry.
He is tall enough to touch it.
items.topic: পর্ব ২ — কারণ, উদ্দেশ্য ও ফল (Reason • Purpose • Result)

items.title: If + Present, Future (First Conditional)
items.body:
If it rains, I shall not go out.
If you work hard, you will be successful.

items.title: If + Present, may/might/can/must/should
items.body:
If you want to succeed, you must work hard.
If you want, you may use my pen.

items.title: If + Past Simple, would/could/might (Second Conditional)
items.body:
If I were a bird, I would fly.
If I had the wings of a bird, I would fly to my friend.

items.title: If + Past Perfect, would/could/might have + V3 (Third Conditional)
items.body:
If I had seen him, I would have told him.
If the driver had been careful, he could have avoided the accident.

items.title: Had + Subject + V3, … would have + V3 (If-ছাড়া Inversion)
items.body:
Had I earned much money, I would have established a new school.
Had he got the job, he would have helped his family.

items.title: If / Whether (কিনা অর্থে — Noun Clause)
items.body:
He asked me if/whether my name was Rajan.
I do not know whether he will come here or not.

items.title: Unless (যদি না / না হলে)
items.body:
Unless you work hard, you cannot shine in life.
You will miss the bus unless you start now.

items.title: In case (যদি কোনো কিছু ঘটে — আগাম সতর্ক তা)
items.body:
He carries an umbrella in case it rains.
Call me in case you need any help.

items.title: Provided / Provided that / Providing that (যদি/তবে শর্ত থাকে যে)
items.body:
I shall help you provided you come in time.
He will pass the examination provided he studies well.

items.title: But for (… না থাকলে/না হলে)
items.body:
But for your cordial co-operation, I might not have succeeded.
But for his negligence, he could have secured a good result.

items.title: As if / As though (যেন)
items.body:
He talks as if he knew everything.
She behaved as though she were mad.
He behaved as if he had won the lottery.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: As … as (সমান/মতো)
items.body:
Her teeth are as bright as pearls.
I am as tall as he.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: Though / Although / Even though (যদিও … তবুও)
items.body:
Though the man is rich, he is dishonest.
Although we walked fast, we could not catch the train.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: Would that / I wish / Were / Had (যদি এমন হতো)
items.body:
I wish I were a child again.
Would that I could fly in the sky.
Had I much money, I would set up a school.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: Would rather … than (বরং … তবু নয়)
items.body:
I would rather starve than steal.
He would rather sleep than gossip with those bad boys.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: Had better (বরং ভালো)
items.body:
You had better start right now.
I had better eat something.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: It is high time / It is time (এখনই উপযুক্ত সময়)
items.body:
It is high time we started our journey.
It is high time she started dieting and exercising.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: No sooner … than / Scarcely/Hardly … when (… না হতেই …)
items.body:
No sooner had we gone out than it began to rain.
Scarcely had we reached college when it started raining.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: Let alone (… তো দূরের কথা)
items.body:
He cannot buy a bicycle, let alone a motor cycle.
She can't ride a bicycle, let alone a motorcycle.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: But / Or / Otherwise / Neither…nor / Not only…but also (সংযোজক clause)
items.body:
Speak the truth or you will be dishonoured everywhere.
She neither eats meat nor drinks milk.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: The … the … (যত … তত …)
items.body:
The sooner we get up, the more time we get to work.
The warmer the weather, the better I feel.
items.topic: পর্ব ৪ — বৈপরীত্য ও বিশেষ কাঠামো (Contrast • Special Structures)

items.title: Whom / Who (যাকে … তাকে)
items.body:
The boy whom you saw is my uncle.
This is the boy whom I like very much.

items.title: Whose (যার … / যাদের …)
items.body:
This is the boy whose father is a teacher.
The pen whose cap was lost has been found.

items.title: Whoever (যে-ই)
items.body: Whoever you are, we cannot allow you to go in.

items.title: Which / That / Who (Relative Clause)
items.body:
This is the book which I bought yesterday.
Self- help is the best help and Allah helps those who help themselves.

items.title: What (যা … তা)
items.body:
We understood what he said.
What is lotted cannot be blotted.

items.title: Whatever (যা-ই)
items.body: Whatever he says is false/true.

items.title: Where / Wherever (যেখানে … সেখানে)
items.body:
This is the village where I was born.
Where there is a will, there is a way.

items.title: When (সময়বাচক Noun-এর পরে: the time/year/day when)
items.body:
1971 is the year when Bangladesh became independent.
26 March is the date when we observe our independence.

items.title: How (যেভাবে, কীভাবে)
items.body:
I do not know how the man died.
Do you know how I can learn English well?

items.title: However (যতই … হোক না কেন)
items.body: However strong you may be, you cannot carry this heavy load.

items.title: Why (কেন, কী কারণে)
items.body:
Do you know why he often comes here?
We do not know the reason why he comes here.

items.title: Noun Clause (that / wh-clause + বাক্যের অংশ)
items.body:
She confessed that she had made a mistake.
There goes a proverb that a man is known by the company he keeps.

items.title: With a view to (উদ্দেশ্যে) + V-ing
items.body:
He went to Dhaka with a view to finding a suitable job.
We came forward with a view to solving all those problems.
items.topic: পর্ব ৬ — Phrase, Gerund, Infinitive ও প্রবাদ

items.title: Gerund (V-ing) — Preposition / Would you mind / avoid / used to
items.body:
Would you mind opening the window?
I am used to waking up early.
I usually avoid driving my car.
items.topic: পর্ব ৬ — Phrase, Gerund, Infinitive ও প্রবাদ

items.title: Infinitive (to + V1) — অভিপ্রায়/কর্তব্য/in order to
items.body:
He hopes to secure good grade in the HSC Examination.
I collected the newspaper in order to read it and gain knowledge.
items.topic: পর্ব ৬ — Phrase, Gerund, Infinitive ও প্রবাদ

items.title: Prepositional Phrase (Despite / In spite of / Because of / Without)
items.body:
In spite of his being poor, he is honest.
Without studying hard, you can never expect a good result.
items.topic: পর্ব ৬ — Phrase, Gerund, Infinitive ও প্রবাদ

items.title: Noun / Adjective / Adverbial Phrase পূরণ
items.body:
A barking dog seldom bites.
We should follow the example of a bee in our daily life.
items.topic: পর্ব ৬ — Phrase, Gerund, Infinitive ও প্রবাদ

items.title: Proverb / Saying (প্রবাদ-প্রবচন)
items.body:
United we stand, divided we fall.
What is lotted cannot be blotted.
Time and tide wait for none.
items.topic: পর্ব ৬ — Phrase, Gerund, Infinitive ও প্রবাদ
